objective: Implement every remaining DSA topic and all Mathematical & Statistical Foundations topics to the current project teaching standard.
completionPolicy: Every scoped topic needs complete teaching, primary-source accuracy, visual/model/native checks where applicable, independent practice, actual desktop/mobile/keyboard review, and integrated route/loading verification. Publication alone is not completion; user acceptance and observed learning outcomes are separate.
